text:
Sam H: Hey team — follow-up from the postmortem on the 3/18 inference outage. We discovered a recurring pattern (KV-cache eviction + high prefix reuse) that caused intermittent empty streams and huge tail latency. We need concrete testing/evals to catch this before prod. Proposed action items below, please claim ownership and ETA 

Elaine P: +1. I can own the regression prompt-set and eval harness. Will create a PR to add the incident prompts to the evals repo. ETA 2026-04-01.

Devon R: I'll take nightly load tests + dashboards. Need infra to provision a smaller loadgen cluster that can reproduce tail behaviour. Target 2026-04-08.

Marta L: Ops can provision the k8s job and a modest cluster for the generator. I'll open the infra ticket and link it here. ETA 2026-03-30.

ops-bot: INF-3421 created: "provision-loadgen-for-tail-latency-tests" — https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-3421

Sam H: A few specifics to include in the tests:
- Regression prompt set that covers the exact prefixes seen in the outage (highly repetitive tokens + long prefix reuse).
- Nightly tail-latency job that asserts 95/99th percentiles under a synthetic workload (fail if above threshold).
- Chaos drill to simulate KV cache eviction and node flapping for 30m windows.
- Automated eval gating for model PRs (fail on regression), alert-only for infra changes initially.

Sam H: example loadgen command for the infra ticket so it's reproducible:
```bash
# run tail latency test against staging cluster
./tools/loadgen --model redwood-v1 --rps 200 --seq 512 --duration 30m --metrics tail95,tail99 --prefix-set incident_prompts.json
```

Elaine P: For the eval harness I'll add assertions: embedding drift < 0.02, generation completions > 99%, and no empty streams for the prompt set. I'll put those as unit tests that run in CI for model bundles.

Devon R: For dashboards I want 1s histograms and a rolling 24h tail latency alert. Also will add a canary route to compare quantized variant. Suggest route 1% for 48h and automated drift checks.

Sam H: Ownership summary (I'll add these to the postmortem board and create an epic):
- Elaine P: incident_prompt_regression_suite — due 2026-04-01
- Devon R: nightly_tail_load_tests + dashboards + canary config — due 2026-04-08
- Marta L: infra provision (INF-3421) for loadgen + metrics retention — due 2026-03-30
- Sam H: rollout policy & canary routing config PR — due 2026-04-05

Marta L: I'll link INF-3421 to the outage playbook and add runbook steps for the chaos drill. :white_check_mark:

Devon R: Quick question — should failures block PRs or only raise alerts?

Elaine P: For now: block PRs for model changes (we don't want regressions in model code). For infra or non-model changes, alert and notify owners. We can tighten after a stabilization window.

Sam H: Sounds good. I'll update the postmortem doc and create the follow-up epic (will ping the SRE weekly review). Tagging owners: @Elaine P @Devon R @Marta L :rocket: 

Elaine P: I'll start the evals repo PR today and share the prompt-set file once ready.

Marta L: noted, will update INF-3421 with the command above and add a slack webhook for test completion.

Sam H: Thanks everyone. We'll review progress in next week's SRE sync. :thumbsup:
